The protagonist and one of the six Crowns, the leaders of The Academy. He is the only male Crown and has been invited to The Academy as a transfer student by the Chairman Kurofune. His past is shrouded in mystery, and he hides within him an incredible power. He challenges the foundations of The Academy over and over again, dismissing the challenges that the other Crowns set out for him.

He possesses an unshakable and iron will, and acts as though the world revolves around him, though he does have a clear sense of respect for that which he accredits value. Surprisingly, he's not very detail-oriented, as shown by his refusal to use instruction manuals.

Has lived abroad for years, resulting in his somewhat quirky personality. He's viewed as a bit of an unusual man, but is largely unfazed by how others see him. He goes crazy over large boobs, and especially enjoys groping them.
"I've surpassed all suffering, followed the path of fate's string... And have finally arrived at my promised stage."

In her 7th and second to last year of schooling at The Academy, Saku is the distinguished head of the Crowns. She is very embodiment of nobility that every student in the academy strives to live up to, garnering respect and awe from one and all. The task of escorting Shinri around the academy, and helping to familiarize him with the place is left to her. Due to that fact, the two are often seen together on a daily basis.

Saku is a proud, sublime specimen of a girl; even calling her a "queen" would be no overstatement. As the leader of the Crowns, she works tirelessly to uphold and enforce law and order within the academy. She would stand before anyone who threatened to disrupt the status quo of her beloved academy, regardless of who they may be. And, although Shinri saved her life from the terrorists, he unfortunately threatens to disrupt the peace within the academy; as such, she's left with no choice but to stop him by any means necessary.

She strives to be a role model for the other students, and because of this, judges herself far more harshly than those around her. In truth, some students find it hard to approach her when this aspect of personality surfaces. Her personality is the polar opposite of a man like Shinri, who lives his life unbound by any rules whatsoever, letting nothing stand in the way of his freedom. Precisely because of the fact, she finds that she cannot help but be curious about him and his eccentric way of living. For his part, Shinri takes a liking to her and dubs her the "Goddess of Gargantuan Gazongas," much to her chagrin. She loves sweet things and can often be found sucking on hard candies.
"For the nobility of the people."

7th-year student who is the Crowns' prized treasurer. She is one of the eldest students of the recently-established Amakawa Noble Academy, standing up there alongside Saku. Her father is the famously wealthy Niiyama Katsuragi, so she's a bonafide noble in her own right.

Nobody really knows why she dresses in men's clothing, but she certainly doesn't act like one, as she's a girly girl through and through. She's best friends with Saku. Though in some ways, they couldn't be more different, with Sorako having a bit of a naive side to her. Her boundless kindness toward others means that when she spots someone in trouble, she can't help reach out to them to try and help in whatever ways she can. It's literally impossible for her to be on bad terms with anyone. She's even willing to hang out with Shinri, despite him being the Crowns' "sworn enemy."

Aside from Saku, Sorako is considered the greatest talent at The Academy. Exercise is her weak point, and she's much clumsier than one might assume at a glance. Shinri sees through her clothes with great ease, and discovers her to be the owner of a pair of massive mammaries; her disguises are powerless before his discerning eye. Her favorite things in life are helping others, and a nice cup of tea after a meal. She sometimes even wears glasses, giving her the "Bespectacled Beauty" attribute, which is highly prized by fellows of good taste.
"Study me to your heart's content."

A 6th-year student and the newest addition to the Crowns; she works as the general affairs manager. She's a reformed delinquent, so she has a bit of an attitude compared to the other Crowns. Often comes off extremely rude when talking to people, earning herself no ending scolding from Saku.

She's a genius when it comes to physical activities, as proved by her mastery of a mysterious ancient Japanese martial art that has been passed down through her family for generations. Tamao is unparalleled and downright invincible in a fight. She doesn't present herself very "nobly" at all, so while there are many who respect her, there are equally as many who fear her. Nevertheless, her behavior has earned her the adoration of many a younger girl, and she's stolen a lot of young maidens' hearts.

Her first impression of Shinri could not have been any worse, and she can't help but snap at him whenever they're in the same room. It's not immediately obvious because of how she comes off to people, but she treasures her friends dearly and is quite overprotective of her fellow Crowns; in fact, she would fight against the entire world for them. Her moderate mounds are nothing to scoff at, but Big Boob Boss Shinri doesn't consider them worth the time of day. She's sworn to totally kick hiss ass for that one day.
"Who're you calling a meathead, huh?! I'll smash your skull open and turn your brain into garden fertilizer!!!"

A 5th-year student and the youngest of the Crowns, she works as their secretary. Formerly known as "Saku's personal chevalier," a title that didn't mean much more than explain her status as a self-designated servant, she still thinks of herself as Saku's knight in shining armor.

Cool-headed to the point of being near-expressionless most of the time, Eru calls herself the Crowns' most brilliant tactician. To her, Saku is love, Saku is life, and anyone who disagrees is not fit to live. Naturally, she absolutely loathes Shinri for daring to oppose Saku. She's ever ready to pounce on the opportunity to put him six feet under.

She can be extremely harsh to people she dislikes, and her sharp words are made even worse by the icy expression that usually accompanies them. Absolutely adores red kidney beans, and if anyone dares to make fun of them, she'll turn them into a beanbag. In case you couldn't tell, she's quite the eccentric herself. Seeing as she's flatter than freshly paved ground, Shinri could not possibly be less interested in her peerless booblessness.
"I, Eru Takazaki, have a flawless plan. Your next opponent shall be me, the Crowns' most brilliant tactician."

As his surname suggests, he's the son of Chairman Kurofune. Taigi's not actually a student at The Academy, despite how often he hangs around the premises. Additionally, he has quite the artistic soul, and though he tries to play the aloof artist most of the time, the truth is he's rather sensitive and prone to buckling under pressure.

Taigi and Shinri hit it off at first, as their hobbies seem to align, but a fatal difference in their aesthetics brings their whole dynamic crashing down. His self-effacing conceals his thoughts from the world, so nobody can truly ever tell what he's thinking. However, despite his mysterious ways, there tends to be nuggets of wisdom and information to Shinri to discover hidden within his words...
"Paintings are truly wonderful. They capture those precious ephemeral moments in life and allow them to live on for eternity."
